description: This header file defines functions and constants related to engine configuration settings, including initialization, printing states, and engine type management.

methods.name: printSpiState
methods.description: Prints the SPI state using the provided logger and board configuration.

methods.name: setCallFromPitStop
methods.description: Sets a call with specified duration in milliseconds from pit stop.

methods.name: getConfigurationName
methods.description: Returns the configuration name corresponding to the engine type.
